exposure: Patient's response to a pain rating questionnaire preoperatively
Patient's pain score during local anesthetic infiltration (LAI)
Anesthesiologist's prediction of postcesarean pain severity
outcome: Postoperative pain scores at rest and with movement
cohort: The study included ninety women undergoing scheduled cesarean delivery under spinal anesthesia.
finding: Combining a preoperative pain rating questionnaire with an anesthesiologist's prediction of postcesarean pain severity accounted for 27% of the variance in mean postoperative pain with movement.
